title: Characterization of valid configuration records
statement: For natural numbers $k,n,s$, types $Q,T$, and a list $f$ of lists of recording symbols, $f$ is a valid record for some Boolean input of length $n$, a configuration whose work-tape heads and nonblank cells lie within distance $s$ of the origin, and some tag if and only if $f$ has length $k+3$; its first field is a singleton state symbol; its second field is the fixed-width binary digit list of some natural number $v\le n+1$, with width equal to the number of binary digits in $n+1$; each of the next $k$ fields lists $2s+1$ tape cells, with arbitrary optional Boolean contents and a mark on exactly one position $m<2s+1$; and its final field is a singleton tag symbol.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a list of lists of recording symbols
